feedback_request.integration_feedback: Report line_loss_events per track against 0.9 on s-bend and 1.0 on slalom at y=0.06. Report progress on s-bend and slalom against 0.146 and 0.100. Report whether the row at y=0.045 gives a usable signal on the curves and whether steering_oscillation on slalom stays below about 0.15. State explicitly whether the oval max_error floor (about 0.061) moved at all, since that rules out sensor lookahead as the floor lever.

intent: Single-lever change from iteration 7: move the sensor row from y=0.06 to y=0.045, keeping the ±0.055 span, 16 mm footprints, 0.12 m track, 0.035 m wheels, 0.12 m body width and 0.6 kg mass. The aim is to clear the s-bend and slalom line losses that appeared at y=0.06 while keeping most of the bend progress gain. Expected: line_loss_events at 0 on s-bend and slalom, s-bend progress between 0.04 and 0.157, and slalom steering_oscillation at or below about 0.13.
learning: Pending this race. The ±0.055 span at y=0.06 did not clear losses, so the loss comes from the forward row, not span. If y=0.045 clears losses with progress above 0.04 on s-bend, keep it and test whether a smaller footprint (0.012 m) moves the oval floor. If losses persist at y=0.045, the loss depends on the robot's speed on the curve, and the next lever is the controller's base_speed, which belongs to the Integrator.
rationale: Iteration 7 widened the outer sensors from ±0.05 to ±0.055 at the forward row (y=0.06). Its score was 50.25, slightly below iteration 6's 51.67. The span change did not remove the line losses: s-bend averaged 0.9 losses per trial and slalom 1.0, with progress down on s-bend (0.157 to 0.146) and unchanged on slalom (0.100). So span is not the cause of the losses at this row. Iteration 5 (y=0.03, ±0.05) had zero losses, and iterations 2 and 4 showed ±0.05 or wider removes losses at y=0.03. The loss appears when the row moves forward, which points to the forward row itself, consistent with the Integrator's rule. Forward sensing is the only lever that has moved bend progress (s-bend 0.040 to 0.157 from y=0.03 to y=0.06). The oval floor (max_error 0.061 to 0.063, progress 0.115) has not moved under any geometry change, and I am not chasing it further in this step. The next change is the Integrator's requested intermediate step: move the row to y=0.045 and keep the ±0.055 span from iteration 7. I expect this to clear the line losses on s-bend and slalom while keeping part of the forward-sensing progress gain. If it works, the score should rise above 50 because the loss penalty goes away. If progress falls below iteration 6 values with no losses, the robot needs more forward reach, not less, and the next step is to return to y=0.06 with ±0.05.
